name: Harlequin’s Costume
body:
Price 23,700 gp; Slot body; CL 7th; Weight 4 lbs.; Aura faint transmutation and moderate abjuration

DESCRIPTION

This tight-fitting entertainer’s outfit is made of flashy patches of different colors, like the costumes usually worn by court fools and street performers. It confers a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics skill checks and a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class. Once per day, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 11,850 GP; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells cat’s grace, freedom of movement
